title: 第1章 被疯子劫持的傻子
content_zh:
天气尚未转暖，冷冽的寒风撕扯着平安一中门前的国旗，猎猎作响。

这个点本应该是学校做早操的时间，但高中部教学楼前却乱成了一锅粥。

“秦朗，你还傻站着干什么？赶紧跑呀！”昏昏沉沉的秦朗，隐约听到一个声音擦肩而过。

“甭管他，这傻逼又犯二了，吓得连眼都不敢睁，咱们赶紧跑，等警察过来就安全了。”又一个声音匆匆在秦朗的耳边经过。

秦朗头疼欲裂，眼皮重如千斤，浑身不能动弹。

他费力的将眼皮拉开了一道缝隙，突如其来的光亮，刺得他瞳孔紧缩，又酸又痛。

直到慢慢适应了外界的光线，压迫在眼皮上的力量以及浑身上下的束缚感，这才渐渐消失。

恢复视力的秦朗，困惑的发现周围的一切都很陌生。

他看到许多少年男女，正慌乱地跑动着。

不远处，一个身上沾染着血迹的青年男子，挥动着手中的条状物体，疯狂追逐。

“奇怪，这是什么地方？我怎么会在这里？”

秦朗清楚的记得，自己明明是在炼丹，只不过在关键时刻遭到仇人尸山海的破坏，导致丹炉发生爆炸，他被一股气浪掀起来，眼前一黑，再睁开眼，眼前出现的就是这样一幅莫名其妙的画面。

秦朗心里猛地一揪，寂灭神丹就是他之前所炼制的丹药。这并不是一枚普通的丹药，乃是整个丹鼎大陆仅存于传说中，从未有人炼成过的至高神丹。

据说只要炼成此丹，便能获得永生，成为不朽，成为传奇。

为了炼制这枚神丹，秦朗足足准备了五百年的时间，本来成功在望，没想到最后却因为尸山海而功亏一篑。

一想到这些，秦朗就心疼的厉害，同时对尸山海也是恨之入骨，恨不得立刻能将他挫骨扬灰，碎尸万段。

“不行，我得立刻回炼丹的地方看看，虽然丹炉爆炸，但也许寂灭神丹已经炼成了。”心思一动，秦朗心情就迫切起来。

他要先弄清楚眼前所处的到底是什么地方，好确定方向以最快的速度返回之前的炼丹之地。

刚打定主意，秦朗就听到不远处传来一个惊慌失措的声音，“我的妈呀，别来追我，别来追我。”

他转目一看，原来是一个身材瘦小的少年，被那青年男子追的很近，好几次都差点被那条状物体劈中，吓得那少年一边跑一边大喊。

秦朗眉头一皱，目光集中在青年男子手中所握持的条状物体上，凭借直觉和经验，他认出这应当是一把刀。

“没想到这世上竟然有这么丑陋粗糙的刀？”一怔之下，秦朗嘴角泛起了嘲弄之意。

这样的刀根本就是小孩子的玩具，别说伤人，就是切菜都嫌钝的慌，秦朗自然不会放在眼里，更不会有任何威胁感。

“正好需要人问问情况，就他们吧。”秦朗直奔俩人走了过去，浑然不觉自己的做法在旁人眼中多么不可思议。

正仓皇逃窜的瘦小少年，看到迎面而来的秦朗，贼溜溜的眼珠子一亮。

“秦大傻，快帮老子挡一下。”瘦小少年一步跃到秦朗近前，竟然一拉秦朗的胳膊，又狠狠地推了一下秦朗的腰。

秦朗脸色一变，下意识的就要反击，但还没来得及动手，脚步就踉跄起来，生生被推得朝那青年男子撞了过去。

这一撞倒也巧妙，恰好撞在了青年男子举刀的手臂上，使得对方的刀锋偏向了一旁，并没有落在秦朗的身上。

那瘦小少年奸计得逞，见秦朗替他做了挡箭牌，回头露出如释重负的得意笑容，趁机越跑越远。

刚稳住身子，秦朗的脸色就变得十分难看。

“我什么时候变得这么脆弱，居然一个普通人都能轻易将我撞开？还有，对方所用的语言和刚刚昏迷时听到的话，都分明不是丹鼎大陆的通用语言，但为何我却有种耳熟能详的感觉？”

就在他疑窦丛生的时候，被撞得措手不及的青年男子再度举刀，这一次他的目标变成了近在咫尺的秦朗。

“老子砍死你们这些臭婊子教的学生。”青年男子狰狞的骂着，刀锋直指秦朗左肩。

秦朗本就没把青年男子手里的刀当回事，又因为身体的变化而茫然不解，便似个木头桩子一般，没任何反应。

眼看着刀锋就要劈中秦朗，突然远处传来一阵密集的脚步声，紧接着一个洪亮的声音喊道：“住手，把刀放下。”

青年男子脸色一变，“麻痹的，这些警察怎么来的这么快。”

他想也不想的就将劈下的刀锋一收，转而探手抓住了秦朗的衣领，将刀架在了他的脖子上。

“都他妈给我站住。再敢靠过来，信不信老子宰了他？”

远处跑来的十来个人，应声停住了脚步。

领头的中年警察，面色严峻的喊道：“赵铁柱，你的情况我们警方已经完全掌握了。你已经砍伤了好几名学生，构成了严重犯罪。现在把刀放下，你还有改过自新的机会。如果你真的伤害了你手上这名学生，法律必将给予你严惩。”

赵铁柱痛骂道：“别以为你们披着警皮拿着枪，就他妈能吓唬到老子！法律？法律算个屁！你们既然已经掌握了我的情况，难道不知道老子有精神病史？就算杀人，老子也不判刑，有种你们再靠过来试试，看看老子敢不敢宰了这小子。”

听到这话，中年警察眉头一皱，暗中示意周围同伴不要轻举妄动。

警察的出现，让周围奔逃的人流找到了定心骨，他们渐渐止住了脚步，聚拢到四周，远远的围观。

“原来这家伙是个神经病啊，难怪跟疯了似的跑到咱们学校到处砍人，他手上那倒霉孩子是谁呢？”

“他你都不认识？高三十班的秦朗啊！有名的傻逼。听说打娘胎里出来的时候，智商就比较低。”

“想起来了，他外号叫秦大傻对吧？真是百闻不如一见，难怪刚刚大家都在跑，就他闭着眼站着不动，活该被那神经病给挟持了。”

有人好奇，有人嘲讽，有人同情，有人指指点点，几乎每个人的目光都落在了秦朗的身上。

远远的听到那些议论声，秦朗一脑门的问号，更有种奇怪的感觉，觉得那些人议论的似乎是另一个和他同名同姓的人。

“到底是哪个环节出错了？”一头雾水的秦朗，也顾不上去理会身后那个赵铁柱的挟持了，下意识的就想挣脱，去寻找问题的根源。

谁知道，他身子刚一动，赵铁柱就立刻勒紧了他的脖子，出声威胁道：“小子，给我安分点儿，再他妈乱动，老子给就给你放血。”

秦朗眼中杀机毕露，打从一开始他就没将这个赵铁柱，以及他所持的凶器放在眼里。

这种程度的威胁，在他看来，不过是蝼蚁的伎俩，就算主动迎向刀锋，他也有信心，这等凡物打造的劣质刀刃，根本伤不了他的肉身分毫。

若非自身以及周围的情况很不对劲，让他没心思跟这个赵铁柱计较，他早就将出手干掉此人。但现在既然对方不识抬举，再三挑衅，他岂能任由其撒野？

于是，秦朗右手一抬，并指一挥，陡然大喝道：“烽火轮，杀！”

围观者因秦朗特异举动，为之一静。

片刻过去，秦朗预想中，烽火轮出，瞬间灭敌的场景并没有出现。

“咦？怎么烽火轮一点动静都没有？甚至我都感应不到它的存在？”

秦朗眼中闪过一丝迷茫，心里有些奇怪，他再度重复刚才的动作，大喝道：“烽火轮！杀！杀！杀！”

三个杀字，声声震耳，气势不凡，配合特定的动作，让秦朗浑身上下散发着凛然不可侵犯的高手气概。

“不可能，烽火轮是我性命交修的法宝，已经通灵，怎么可能对我这个主人的召唤，没有丝毫回应？”

秦朗不信邪的第三次大喊道：“烽火轮，给我现身！”

可惜，一如前两次一样，除了他在那里张牙舞爪的大喊，根本没有其他的动静出现。

周围每个人的脸上都闪过错愕的表情。

紧接着，一阵哄堂大笑像是传染一般，从人群中蔓延开来。

秦朗这一连串诡异的动作和话语，落在围观的人眼中，完全就是一种神经质的滑稽表演。

“我靠，这小子脑残了吧？还风火轮？他当自己是哪吒呢？”

“这小子本来就是脑残，我们班有名的二百五，你要是知道他的底细，就见怪不怪了。”

“靠了，忘记把这二逼刚刚的表现录下来，要是发到微博上去，取个标题，叫《被疯子劫持的傻子》，肯定暴火！”

在哄笑之后，各种议论声便抑制不住的滋生出来，搞得周围好像菜市场一样。

他惊骇的发现，自己完全感应不到烽火轮的存在，好像他从来就不曾拥有过一样。

“你他娘的，是不是以为老子在跟你开玩笑？”恶狠狠的声音从秦朗的背后传来。

紧接着，刀柄狠狠的敲在了他的头上。

落点恰好在太阳穴的位置，秦朗顿时头晕目眩，两眼冒金花。

也不知道是不是因为这一击，触动了他脑海深处的潜伏的记忆，突然一股乱七八糟的信息，涌现出来。

忍着头疼欲裂的痛楚，秦朗一点一点读取着这些信息，脸上露出难以置信的表情。

秦朗，现年十九岁，就读于平安一中高三十班。出生时，母亲难产死亡，因宫内窘迫导致严重缺氧，出生以后被诊断出智商底下，长大后博得了一个傻子的称号。

父亲秦逢阳，退伍军人，创办秦氏酒业，家庭富裕。妻亡后，秦逢阳续弦，是为秦朗继母，名为曹艳，并再生一子，取名秦胜。

“这怎么可能？我竟然从丹鼎大陆，跑到了这个叫做地球的星球上来。而且还附身在了一个同名同姓的凡人少年身上，更重要的是，这少年还是个傻子。”
content_en:
The weather had not warmed yet, and the cold wind tore the national flag in front of the Ping An Yizhong Gate, hunting and hunting.

This point should have been the time for the school to do morning exercises, but the front of the high school teaching building became a pot of porridge.

"Qin Lang, why are you still standing there? Run!" Drowsy Qin Lang, vaguely heard a voice brushing his shoulders.

"Leave him alone. This idiot has committed another crime. He's so scared that he can't even keep his eyes open. Let's hurry and run. We'll be safe when the police come over. Another voice hurried past Qin Lang's ear.

Qin Lang's head was aching, his eyelids were as heavy as a thousand pounds, and he couldn't move his whole body.

He struggled to open a gap in his eyelids, and the sudden brightness made his pupils tight, sore and painful.

This gradually disappeared until she slowly adapted to the external light, the force pressing on the eyelids, and the sense of restraint all over her body.

Restoring her eyesight, Qin Lang was puzzled to discover that everything around her was unfamiliar.

他看到许多少年男女，正慌乱地跑动着。

Not far away, a young man with blood stains on his body waved the strip-like object in his hand and chased frantically.

"Strange, what is this place? Why am I here?"

Qin Lang clearly remembered that he was clearly in the alchemy pill, but at a critical moment, he was damaged by the enemy's corpses and mountains, which led to the explosion of the pill furnace. He was lifted up by a wave of air. His eyes went dark and he opened his eyes again. What appeared in front of him was such an inexplicable picture.

Qin Lang snapped in his heart. Annihilation Divine Pill was the pill he had refined before. This was not an ordinary pill, but the entire Danding Continent existed only in legend and had never been refined into a Supreme Divine Pill.

It is said that as long as you refine this pill, you can gain eternal life, become immortal, and become a legend.

In order to refine this divine pill, Qin Langzu had been preparing for five hundred years. He was expecting success, but he did not expect to lose success in the end because of the mountains and seas of corpses.

As soon as he thought of this, Qin Lang was heartbroken. At the same time, he hated the mountains and seas of the corpse. He hoped that he could immediately beat him to ashes and shatter the corpse.

"No, I have to go back to the place where the pill was refined immediately. Although the pill furnace exploded, perhaps the Annihilation Divine Pill has been refined. With a move of heart, Qin Lang's mood became urgent.

He had to figure out where he was in front of him first, so that he could determine the direction to return to the former alchemy place as quickly as possible.

As soon as he made up his mind, Qin Lang heard a panicked voice coming from not far away, "Oh my God, don't come after me, don't come after me."

He turned around and saw that it was a thin teenager who was chased very close by the young man. On several occasions, he was almost struck by the object, which frightened the teenager as he ran and shouted.

Qin Lang frowned and focused his eyes on the strip held in the young man's hand. With his intuition and experience, he recognized that this should be a knife.

"I didn't expect there to be such an ugly and rough knife in this world? Qin Lang mocked at the corner of his mouth.

Such a knife is basically a child's toy. Don't say that it hurts people, that is, it is blunt to cut vegetables. Qin Lang will naturally not look at it, let alone have any sense of threat.

"Just in time for someone to ask about the situation, let's leave them alone. Qin Lang went straight to the two of them and didn't realize how incredible his approach was in the eyes of others.

The skinny teenager who fled from Emperor Zhengcang saw Qin Lang coming on the other side, and the thief's slithering eyes lit up.

"Daisy Qin, help Lao Tzu stop him. The thin teenager jumped to Qin Lang's front and actually pulled Qin Lang's arm and pushed Qin Lang's waist fiercely.

Qin Lang's face changed, and he had to counterattack subconsciously, but before he could start, his footsteps stumbled and he was pushed towards the young man.

This knock was also ingenious. It happened to hit the young man's knife-raising arm, so that the other party's blade leaned to the side and did not fall on Qin Lang's body.

The skinny teenager succeeded in his treachery. Seeing that Qin Lang made a shield for him, he looked back with a smug smile as if relieved, and took the opportunity to run farther and farther.

刚稳住身子，秦朗的脸色就变得十分难看。

"When did I become so vulnerable that an ordinary person could easily break me apart? Also, the language used by the other party and the words he heard when he was just unconscious are clearly not the common language of Danding Continent, but why do I have a familiar feeling?"

Just when he was suspicious of sinuses, the young man who was caught off guard raised his knife again, and this time his target became Qin Lang, who was close at hand.

"Lao Tzu hacked the students you bitch taught. The young man cursed fiercely, and the blade pointed straight at Qin Lang's left shoulder.

Qin Langben did not take the knife in the young man's hand seriously, and was confused because of the changes in his body. It was like a wooden stake, and there was no reaction.

Seeing that the blade was about to strike Qin Lang, suddenly there was a dense sound of footsteps in the distance, followed by a loud voice shouting: "Stop, put the knife down."

The young man's face changed. "It's paralyzing. How did these cops get here so quickly?"

Unexpectedly, he retracted the slashed blade, then grabbed Qin Lang's collar and put the knife on his neck.

"Everybody stop fucking here. Dare to lean over again, do you believe Lao Tzu killed him?"

远处跑来的十来个人，应声停住了脚步。

The leading middle-aged policeman shouted grimly, "Zhao Tiezhu, we have completely mastered your situation. You have slashed and injured several students, which constitutes a serious crime. Now put the knife down, you still have a chance to reform. If you really hurt the student in your hand, the law will punish you severely.”

Zhao Tiezhu cursed in pain, "Don't think that you can scare Lao Tzu with a gun in your police skins! Law? Law is fart! Now that you have mastered my situation, do you not know that Lao Tzu has a history of mental illness? Even if I kill someone, I won't be sentenced. You guys should come over and try again to see if I dare to kill this kid."

Hearing this, the middle-aged policeman frowned and implicitly signaled to the companions around him not to act rashly.

The emergence of the police allowed the people fleeing around to find their peace of mind. Gradually, they stopped, gathered around, and watched from afar.

"So this guy is a psychopath. No wonder he's running all over our school like crazy. Who is that hapless child on his hand?"

"You don't even know him? Qin Lang of the 30th high class! Famous idiots. I heard that when she came out of the womb, her IQ was lower."

"I remember, his nickname is Qin Dazu, right? It's really hard to tell. No wonder everyone was running just now. As long as he stood still with his eyes closed, he deserved to be kidnapped by that psychopath."

Some people were curious, some were mocking, some were sympathetic, some were pointing, and almost everyone's eyes fell on Qin Lang.

Hearing those arguments from afar, Qin Lang's question mark in his head had a strange feeling that those people seemed to be talking about another person with the same name as him.

“Which link went wrong? Qin Lang, who was confused, could not pay attention to the abduction of Zhao Tiezhu behind him. Subconsciously, he wanted to break free and find the source of the problem.

Who knows, as soon as he moved his body, Zhao Tiezhu immediately tightened his neck and threatened, "Kid, give me some peace of mind, and then move around. I'll let you bleed if I give it to you."

In Qin Lang's eyes, the killing machine was exposed. From the beginning, he did not take this Zhao Tiezhu and the murder weapon he held into his eyes.

In his view, this level of threat was nothing more than an ant's trick. Even if he took the initiative to face the blade, he was confident that the inferior blade made by such mortal things could not hurt his flesh at all.

If it weren't for something very wrong with himself and his surroundings, he wouldn't be able to compare himself with this Zhao Tiezhu. He would have killed this person a long time ago. But now that the other party does not know how to raise it and provokes it repeatedly, can he let it go wild?

So, Qin Lang raised his right hand, pointed and shouted loudly, "Beacon Wheel, kill!"

围观者因秦朗特异举动，为之一静。

Moments passed, Qin Lang expected that the beacon fire would turn out, and the scene of instantly extinguishing the enemy did not appear.

"Eh? Why isn't there any movement on the flame wheel? I can't even sense its presence?"

A trace of confusion flashed in Qin Lang's eyes. He felt a little strange in his heart. He repeated the action just now and shouted loudly, "Beacon Wheel! Kill! Kill! Kill!"

The three words killed, the sound shocked the ears, and the vigor was extraordinary. With the specific action, Qin Lang exuded an impenetrable high-handedness all over his body.

"Impossible. Fiery Wheel is a magic weapon for my life. It is already psychic. How can there be no response to my master's call?"

Qin Lang cried out for the third time, "Beacon Wheel, show yourself!"

Unfortunately, as on the previous two occasions, there was no other movement except for his shouting of his fangs and claws.

周围每个人的脸上都闪过错愕的表情。

Immediately after, a burst of laughter spread from the crowd as if it were contagious.

This series of strange actions and words of Qin Lang fell into the eyes of the onlookers, which was completely a nervous antics.

"Damn it, isn't this kid brainwashed? Hot Wheels? Where does he think he is?"

"This kid is originally a brain wreck. Our class has a famous 250. If you know his details, you won't be surprised."

"Shit, I forgot to record the performance of these two compulsions just now. If I send it to Weibo and take a title and call it" Fools Hijacked by Madmen ", it will surely be a firestorm!"

After the laughter, all kinds of arguments could not be suppressed, making the surroundings look like a vegetable market.

He was shocked to find that he could not completely sense the existence of the Beacon Wheel, as if he had never owned it before.

"You motherfucker, don't you think I'm joking with you?" A fierce voice came from behind Qin Lang.

紧接着，刀柄狠狠的敲在了他的头上。

The landing point happened to be at the temple location. Qin Lang was dizzy and his eyes blossomed.

I don't know if it was because of this blow, it touched the latent memory deep in his mind, and suddenly a messy message appeared.

With the pain of cracking his head, Qin Lang read the information bit by bit, showing an incredulous expression on his face.

Qin Lang, now nineteen years old, enrolled in the 30th class of Ping 'an No. 1 Middle and High School. At birth, her mother died of obstructed labor. She suffered from severe hypoxia due to intrauterine distress. After being diagnosed with IQ after birth, she won the title of a fool when she grew up.

His father Qin Fengyang, a veteran, founded the Qin liquor industry, and his family was wealthy. After the death of his wife, Qin Fengyang continued to play for Qin Lang's stepmother, named Cao Yan, and gave birth to another son, named Qin Sheng.

"How is this possible? I actually ran from Danding Continent to this planet called Earth. And also possessed a mortal teenager with the same name. More importantly, this teenager is still a fool."
